heard: This is the family line of Noah, Shem, and Ham, and Japheth born. Sons were born to them after the flood, the nations spread from the storm. The sons of Ham came from the water, Cush and Egypt and Put Canaan was with them in the land, They moved out from the hut Siba and Havilah stand together Saptah and Ramah follow Saptah and Ramah follow
